title: Senior Human Resource Executive
description:
Job Description HR Generalist Company: Brigade Group ( Regent Club) 
 Department: Human Resources & Admin 
 Location: Whitefield 1. Job Purpose To manage day-to-day HR operations and provide comprehensive HR support across recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, performance management, payroll coordination, employee relations, and statutory compliance, ensuring effective implementation of HR policies and business objectives. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Coordinate with department heads to understand manpower requirements. Manage recruitment activities, including sourcing, screening, interview scheduling, and offer coordination. Facilitate joining formalities and ensure timely closure of vacancies. Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular hiring updates. B. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management Manage employee onboarding, induction, confirmation, transfers, and separation formalities. Maintain employee records, personnel files, and HRMS data. Coordinate appointment letters, employment documentation, and exit formalities. Ensure accurate and timely updating of employee information. C. Payroll & Attendance Management Coordinate attendance, leave, overtime, and payroll inputs with the Payroll/HR Operations team. Validate employee data and resolve payroll-related queries. Monitor attendance and leave records and ensure timely submission of monthly inputs. D. Employee Engagement & Employee Relations Coordinate employee engagement activities, celebrations, and welfare initiatives. Address employee queries and grievances in coordination with the HR Manager. Support employee retention initiatives and maintain positive employee relations. Assist in disciplinary procedures and employee communication, as required. E. Performance Management & Learning Coordinate performance appraisal, goal-setting, and probation review processes. Track employee confirmations and performance review timelines. Identify training needs and coordinate learning and development initiatives. Support employee development and internal mobility processes. F. Statutory Compliance & HR Governance Support compliance with applicable labour laws and organizational HR policies. Maintain statutory records and documentation required for audits and inspections. Coordinate with relevant teams on applicable statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, gratuity, and other employee benefits. Support POSH awareness and compliance activities, as applicable. G. HR MIS & Reporting Prepare periodic HR reports covering headcount, attrition, absenteeism, recruitment, and employee movements. Maintain accurate HR trackers and dashboards. Support HR audits and ensure proper documentation and record maintenance. Provide timely reports to the Unit HR Manager and corporate HR team. 3. Educational Qualification MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or a postgraduate qualification in HR. A bachelor's degree with relevant HR experience may also be considered. 4. Experience 3–8 years of experience in HR Generalist / HR Operations roles. Experience in real estate, construction, hospitality, property management, or other operational environments is preferred.

Key Skills: Talent acquisition,HR operations,HR generalist activities,Acquisition,Labor,Relationship,Hrsd,Labor Compliance

 Location: Bengaluru
 Employment Type: Full-Time | Work from Office

 Budget: Up to 5 LPA 
 To Apply, Contact: 89518 70100 hr.bangalore@texasreview.in (Kindly share your resume on WhatsApp or email in case the call is busy) 
 About the Role We are looking for a proactive and experienced HR Manager who can independently manage and oversee end-to-end HR operations across five companies/business entities. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in HR management, recruitment, payroll coordination, employee engagement, HR policies, compliance, and workforce management. The candidate must be capable of handling multiple organizations simultaneously while ensuring smooth and efficient HR operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End HR Operations Independently manage HR functions across five companies. Develop, implement, and maintain HR policies and procedures. Handle employee lifecycle management, including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, and exit formalities. Maintain employee records, attendance, leave management, and HR documentation. 2. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Manage end-to-end recruitment across different departments and companies. Coordinate with department heads to understand hiring requirements. Manage job postings, candidate screening, interviews, salary negotiations, and offer rollouts. Ensure timely closure of vacancies. 3. Payroll & Compensation Management Coordinate and manage monthly payroll processing across all five companies. Handle salary structures, attendance, leave deductions, incentives, and final settlements. Ensure accurate salary records and payroll documentation. 4. Statutory Compliance & HR Administration Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements. Handle PF, ESI, PT, TDS coordination, and other applicable statutory matters. Maintain employee files, appointment letters, offer letters, and other HR documentation. Coordinate with external consultants and payroll vendors wherever required. 5. Employee Relations & Performance Management Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace concerns. Manage performance appraisal and employee review processes. Develop employee engagement and retention initiatives. Support management in workforce planning and HR-related decisions. 6. HR Reporting & Management Coordination Prepare and present monthly HR reports to management. Track headcount, attrition, recruitment status, attendance, and payroll. Coordinate with business heads across all five companies. Ensure consistent HR practices and smooth operations across all entities. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA in HR preferred. 16 years of hands-on experience in HR management or HR operations. Experience independently managing HR functions across multiple companies or business entities. Strong knowledge of recruitment, payroll, HR operations, and statutory compliance. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills. Strong knowledge of labour laws and statutory requirements. Ability to handle multiple priorities and work independently. Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS, and payroll systems. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates who have independently managed HR operations for multiple companies. Experience handling a complete HR function rather than recruitment alone. Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills. Candidates from consulting, education, retail, hospitality, or other multi-entity business environments are preferred. 
 Salary: Up to 5,00,000 per annum, depending on experience and interview performance. To Apply, Contact: 89518 70100 hr.bangalore@texasreview.in (Kindly share your resume on WhatsApp or email in case the call is busy) 
 Important: Candidates with only recruitment experience or limited HR operations exposure will not be considered.

Job Details Designation: Business Development Intern Location: Bangalore Working: Full-time internship at our office, 5 days a week Duration: 3-6 months Experience: 0 to 1 year; final-year students and recent graduates are welcome Job Summary We are looking for energetic, curious and target-oriented interns to work alongside our business development team. You will help us find new clients, generate qualified leads and promote Lares Risk Management s consulting and operational services. This is a hands-on internship. You will not be sitting on the sidelines; you will be making calls, writing to prospects, following up and seeing first-hand how a consulting firm wins business. It suits someone who enjoys talking to people, likes a clear target and wants real commercial experience early in their career. Responsibilities Research and identify prospective clients, decision-makers, sectors and new businesses that could benefit from our services. Support outbound outreach through calls, email, LinkedIn, networking and direct follow-ups. Learn and promote LRM s portfolio of risk management consulting and related services. Help arrange introductory meetings, qualify leads and keep the sales pipeline and CRM tracker accurate and up to date. Assist with proposals, capability presentations, tenders and client follow-ups. Support referral outreach, events and campaigns, and track activity, conversions and outcomes. What We Are Looking For A proactive self-starter who is comfortable approaching people they have not met before. Clear spoken communication and good written English. Working knowledge of MS Office and comfort with digital platforms such as LinkedIn and email tools. The discipline to follow through on tasks and follow-ups without being chased. Willingness to learn quickly and take feedback well. Any prior exposure to sales, lead generation, digital marketing, recruitment, events, student societies or client-facing work will help. An interest in risk, security or geopolitics is a plus, but not a requirement. We will teach you the industry. What You Will Gain Direct mentoring from the business development team and exposure to how senior consultants pitch and win work. A practical understanding of the risk management and security consulting industry. Hands-on experience with B2B outreach, pipeline management, proposals and tenders. A certificate of completion and, based on performance, a letter of recommendation. Success in This Role Looks Like A growing list of qualified prospects, regular client meetings on the calendar, timely follow-ups, stronger visibility for LRM in the market and a measurable contribution to new business by the end of your internship. Interested Please share your CV via the form. If you know someone who would be a good fit, please share this opportunity with them.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 New Business Development Locating potential business deals for the company by contacting potential clients (contractors, developers, architects etc) by discovering and exploring opportunities. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Screen potential business deals by analyzing market strategies, deal requirements and financials Propose potential business deals by contacting potential partners. Call on clients, make presentations on services (online or in person) that meet client s requirements. Set up meetings between client decision makers and company s practice leaders/Principals. Participate in pricing the solution/service. Handle objections by clarifying, emphasizing agreements and working through differences to a positive conclusion. Use a variety of styles to persuade or negotiate appropriately. Client Relationship Management Build and nurture strong relationships with existing and new clients to ensure the sustainable profitable business growth for the system. Work with technical staff and other internal colleagues to meet customer needs. Regularly engage with clients to assess satisfaction and address any concerns. Identify, build and maintain formal and informal networks and productive relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. Business Development Planning Set goals and develop plans for business and revenue growth. Create development plans and forecast sales targets and growth projections. Attend association events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends. Present to and consult with mid and senior level management on business trends with a view to developing new trends in providing services. Using knowledge of the market and competitors, identify and develop the company s unique selling propositions and differentiators.

title: Full cycle Sales Executive
description:
KIM.CC 
 Business Development Representative (Full Cycle) India 
Bengaluru, India (In-Office) | Full-Time | 0-3 years experience
 
 ABOUT KIM.CC 
Kim.cc is an AI-powered customer operations company helping startups and growing businesses scale customer support through a unique AI + Human operating model. We combine experienced support professionals, operational expertise, and AI-enabled workflows to deliver exceptional customer experiences while reducing operational overhead.
We're looking for a highly motivated Full-Cycle Business Development Representative to drive outbound prospecting AND close deals with decision-makers across our target markets this isn't just a lead-gen role, you'll own the deal from first touch to signed contract.
 ROLE OVERVIEW 
As a Full-Cycle BDR, you'll be responsible for the entire sales motion: generating qualified opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting, running discovery and demo calls, handling objections, negotiating terms, and closing deals. This role is best suited for someone who wants ownership of the full sales cycle rather than just booking meetings for someone else to close.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Pipeline Generation: Build and execute outbound prospecting via cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, and account-based targeting.
 Persona Targeting: Identify and engage decision-makers Founders, CEOs, COOs, Heads of CX, and Operations leaders across ecommerce and SaaS companies.
 Discovery & Qualification: Run discovery calls to understand prospect needs and qualify fit.
¢ Demo & Pitch: Deliver product demos and tailor pitches to prospect pain points.
¢ Negotiation & Closing: Handle objections, negotiate pricing/terms, and close deals independently.
¢ Account Management (Early Stage): Support onboarding handoff to ensure a smooth transition post-close.
¢ CRM Ownership: Maintain accurate CRM records and pipeline hygiene across every stage.
¢ Strategic Alignment: Work directly with founders/leadership to refine ICP, messaging, and pricing strategy.
¢ KPI Management: Consistently hit outbound activity, meeting, and closed-revenue targets.
 IDEAL CUSTOMER PROFILE & TARGET PERSONAS 
¢ SaaS companies, Ecommerce & D2C brands, Technology startups, Digital marketplaces, High-growth SMBs.
¢ Buyer personas: Founder/CEO, COO, Head of Operations, Head of Customer Support, VP Customer Success.
 REQUIREMENTS 
¢ Experience: 13 years in BDR, SDR, Inside Sales, or full-cycle sales roles.
¢ Sales Execution: Strong cold-calling, resilience, and closing skills you're comfortable owning a deal from first email to signature.
¢ Communication: Excellent verbal and written English communication.
¢ Tech Stack: Experience with CRM platforms like HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar.
¢ Autonomy: Proven ability to manage a full pipeline independently in a fast-paced environment.
¢ Objection Handling: Comfortable with commercial negotiation and C-level conversations.
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 
¢ Experience selling CX/BPO/SaaS/outsourcing services.
¢ Familiarity with Apollo, ZoomInfo, Outreach, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
¢ Startup experience or experience selling to SMBs/startups.
¢ Understanding of customer support operations and BPO.
 SUCCESS METRICS 
¢ Deals closed per month (not just meetings booked).
¢ Revenue/ARR generated.
¢ Outbound activity volume.
¢ Sales cycle velocity.
¢ CRM data quality and pipeline accuracy.
